summary_bullets: Hardened render-cache publish staging to reject root, dangling-root, tree-contained, and leaf-race symlinks before staging.
Added render-cache symlink regression cases mirroring plan-review coverage, including root, dangling root, leaf, intermediate, and find-to-stage race cases.
Updated design-log publish docs, harness docs, and SECURITY.md with the render-cache fail-closed posture and residual parent-directory race limitation.
commit_message:
Harden render-cache design log staging

Reject render-cache symlinks at the root, anywhere under the resolved physical root, and at the leaf slot immediately before staging. Mirror the plan-review symlink harness coverage and document the remaining parent-directory race surface.
